description: Rescue and Relief Services Furnished By Civil Defense Department By Number of Operations, Injuries, Deaths And Type of Service is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. The dataset provides detailed statistics on rescue and relief services provided by the Civil Defense Department in Qatar, categorized by type of service. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are judicial, security, relief operations, rescue operations, injuries. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency-response and civil-protection studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
